definitions.ask: Should a dangling index row still get a restorable trash entry when its stored file is gone?
definitions.why: payload-less entries reuse existing (None, None) restore semantics and keep the audit trail

choices.label: Store a payload-less trash entry; the row metadata stays restorable and auditable
Remove the row from the live index directly with no trash entry

definitions.ask: How long may a deferred prompt archive stay unresolved before it counts as a digest error?
definitions.why: the worst observed self-resolving case today cleared within about 25 minutes

choices.label: Escalate after 10 minutes; faster alerting, may still emit noise for slow agent turns
Escalate after 30 minutes; covers every transient case observed in the digests
Escalate after 60 minutes; quietest, slowest to surface a genuinely stuck archive

definitions.ask: Should the grace window also skip charging publication attempts toward quarantine?
definitions.why: three 45-second ticks already reach the quarantine threshold while an agent is mid-turn
